name: Respect Husband
overview: Scripture teaches that wives are to respect and submit to their husbands as to the Lord, recognizing the God-ordained order established since the fall of man (Genesis 3:16; Ephesians 5:22). This submission is part of a mutual relationship of reverence and love, where husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ's love for the church (Ephesians 5:25). Believers are encouraged to put away bitterness and anger, fostering unity and submission out of reverence for God (Ephesians 4:31; 5:21). Ultimately, respect for the husband is grounded in following God’s design for family relationships and living as imitators of God (Ephesians 5:1).
